new_concepts.why: Repeat visit for a problem a prior visit was meant to fix; linked to the original ticket; usually no charge. Basis for callback rate by tech/brand/model.
Visits not billed (warranty, goodwill, callback, courtesy): excluded from revenue averages but counted as visits.
Diagnostic/trip charge, often credited toward repair; distinct from invoice total.
Price-book/menu price for a task independent of time, versus hourly T&M.
Plan type with discount %, visits/year, priority service, price, billing cycle; renewal and active/lapsed status.
Scheduled visit under a membership: due, completed, missed.
Good/better/best option on one proposal and which option sold.
Whether a quote was approved, declined or pending; close rate.
Utility/manufacturer/federal incentive tied to equipment install; amount and paperwork.
Customer financing provider, term, APR, monthly payment on a proposal or invoice.
Third-party payer (AHS, Choice) that authorizes and pays warranty jobs; authorization number and NTE limit.
Claim/dispatch/auth # and not-to-exceed amount from a warranty company or property manager.
Pass/fail/correction-required and tag color with inspector and reinspection date.
Measured values (superheat, subcooling, delta-T, static pressure, amp draw, CO ppm) from startup/PM sheets.
Arrival window/ETA and appointment slot.
Emergency/same-day/standard; no heat/no cool flags and after-hours.
Mechanics lien, notice to owner, lien waiver, retainage on commercial/new construction jobs.
Contractor license number, EPA 608, NATE for company and technician credentials.
Resolved on first visit; inverse of callback.
Age/replacement-age from install date or date of manufacture decoded from serial.
Warranty claim/RMA on a defective part, return status, core return.
Spiff/commission/pay-per-job and revenue per tech.
Installer's workmanship warranty, separate from manufacturer parts warranty.
Net 30, due on receipt, COD printed on invoices.
Visit frequency (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly) on a maintenance plan.
